segments.contextBefore: Learn how everything fits together in RealityKit.
segments.contextAfter: RealityKit is a 3D framework designed for building apps, games, and other immersive experiences.
segments.documentTitle: Understanding the modular architecture of RealityKit

segments.source: RealityKit is a 3D framework designed for building apps, games, and other immersive experiences.
segments.normalizedSource: RealityKit is a 3D framework designed for building apps, games, and other immersive experiences.
segments.contextBefore: Overview
segments.contextAfter: Although it’s built in an object-oriented language and uses object-oriented design principles, the architecture of RealityKit avoids heavy use of inheritance — where objects are built by adding instance variables that hold references to other objects — in favor of a modular design based on a paradigm called Entity Component System (ECS) that divides application objects into one of three types.
segments.documentTitle: Understanding the modular architecture of RealityKit

segments.source: Although it’s built in an object-oriented language and uses object-oriented design principles, the architecture of RealityKit avoids heavy use of inheritance — where objects are built by adding instance variables that hold references to other objects — in favor of a modular design based on a paradigm called Entity Component System (ECS) that divides application objects into one of three types.
